cpu_policy: PostgreSQL inherits three-core affinity; single-thread optimizer shares one of those cores and waits during runtime evaluation.
admission_conditions: Before even the 20-worker stage, increase remote /dev/shm to 192 GiB or provide an equivalent validated local database storage layout.
Keep at least 30 GiB cgroup memory free locally and 32 GiB remotely, including database storage and optimizer peak memory.
Keep at least four measured CPU quota cores free on LLMOptimizer2 with no sustained throttling; reserve ten quota cores on LLMOptimizer4 at the 18-worker target.
Increase 20 -> 22 -> 24 only after a concurrency pilot confirms memory, VAE queueing and query timing stability.
Pin each optimizer to a CPU in its own three-core PostgreSQL allocation; it must not fit models asynchronously while its runtime oracle runs.
Do not reinterpret the existing historical four-core runs; validate core sharing before comparing new results.
